allOf.query: Perf | where Computer in ("WIN2019-GUEST","WIN2022-GUEST","WIN2025-GUEST-01") and ObjectName == "Processor Information" and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total" | summarize MemberCPU=avg(CounterValue) by Computer | summarize Value=avg(MemberCPU)
